arxiv-2012-04401.title: Detuning-modulated universal composite pulses
arxiv-2012-04401.creator: Hadar Greener, Elica Kyoseva, Haim Suchowski
arxiv-2012-04401.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Hadar Greener, Elica Kyoseva, Haim Suchowski. We present a general method to derive detuning-modualted composite pulses (DMCPs) as N rotations of a canonical two-state quantum system to create accurate and robust pulses that are independent of the initial state of the system. This scheme has minimal pulse overhead, and achieves pulses that are stable against amplitude errors well within the 10 − 4 10^{-4} threshold that may be suitable for quantum information processing (QIP), within the lifetime of the system.

arxiv-2110-12812.title: Domain Adaptation in Multi-View Embedding for Cross-Modal Video Retrieval
arxiv-2110-12812.creator: Jonathan Munro, Michael Wray, Diane Larlus, Gabriela Csurka, Dima Damen
arxiv-2110-12812.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jonathan Munro, Michael Wray, Diane Larlus, Gabriela Csurka, Dima Damen. Given a gallery of uncaptioned video sequences, this paper considers the task of retrieving videos based on their relevance to an unseen text query. To compensate for the lack of annotations, we rely instead on a related video gallery composed of video-caption pairs, termed the source gallery, albeit with a domain gap between its videos and those in the target gallery.

arxiv-2202-08707.title: Synchronization induced by directed higher-order interactions
arxiv-2202-08707.creator: Luca Gallo, Riccardo Muolo, Lucia Valentina Gambuzza, Vito Latora, Mattia Frasca, Timoteo Carletti
arxiv-2202-08707.description: Abstract Non-reciprocal interactions play a crucial role in many social and biological complex systems. While directionality has been thoroughly accounted for in networks with pairwise interactions, its effects in systems with higher-order interactions have not yet been explored as deserved.

arxiv-2203-01060.title: Reasoning with belief functions over Belnap–Dunn logic
arxiv-2203-01060.creator: Marta Bílková, Sabine Frittella, Daniil Kozhemiachenko, Ondrej Majer, Sajad Nazari
arxiv-2203-01060.description: Abstract We design an expansion of Belnap–Dunn logic with belief and plausibility functions that allows non-trivial reasoning with contradictory and incomplete probabilistic information. We also formalise reasoning with non-standard probabilities and belief functions in two ways. First, using a calculus of linear inequalities, akin to the one presented in [ 23 ] .

arxiv-2203-04786.title: Enhance Topics Analysis based on Keywords Properties
arxiv-2203-04786.creator: Antonio Penta
arxiv-2203-04786.description: Abstract Topic Modelling is one of the most prevalent text analysis technique used to explore and retrieve collection of documents. The evaluation of the topic model algorithms is still a very challenging tasks due to the absence of gold-standard list of topics to compare against for every corpus.

arxiv-2308-12615.title: NAaLoss: Rethinking the Objective of Speech Enhancement
arxiv-2308-12615.description: Abstract Reducing noise interference is crucial for automatic speech recognition (ASR) in a real-world scenario. However, most single-channel speech enhancement (SE) generates ”processing artifacts” that negatively affect ASR performance. Hence, in this study, we suggest a Noise- and Artifacts-aware loss function, NAaLoss, to ameliorate the influence of artifacts from a novel perspective.

arxiv-2411-13846.title: Exploratory Study Of Human-AI Interaction For Hindustani Music
arxiv-2411-13846.creator: Nithya Shikarpur, Cheng-Zhi Anna Huang
arxiv-2411-13846.description: Abstract This paper presents a study of participants interacting with and using GaMaDHaNi, a novel hierarchical generative model for Hindustani vocal contours. To explore possible use cases in human-AI interaction, we conducted a user study with three participants, each engaging with the model through three predefined interaction modes.

arxiv-2501-19165.title: Signatures of Non-Abelian Kitaev quantum spin liquids in noise magnetormetry
arxiv-2501-19165.creator: Xiao Xiao, Masahiro O. Takahashi, Paul Stevenson, Satoshi Fujimoto, Arun Bansil
arxiv-2501-19165.description: Abstract Identification of isolated Majorana zero modes (MZMs) is a key step towards the realization of fault-tolerant topological quantum computation. Here we show how the T 1 T_{1} -based noise magnetormetry of a nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center qubit can reveal the unique signatures of Majorana fermions attached to vacancies in a non-Abelian Kitaev quantum spin liquid (KQSL).

arxiv-2511-22003.title: A Sensitivity Approach to Causal Inference Under Limited Overlap
arxiv-2511-22003.description: Abstract Limited overlap between treated and control groups is a key challenge in observational analysis. Standard approaches like trimming importance weights can reduce variance but introduce a fundamental bias. We propose a sensitivity framework for contextualizing findings under limited overlap, where we assess how irregular the outcome function has to be in order for the main finding to be invalidated.

europmc-pmc3989032.creator: Knight-Jones TJ, Rushton J.
europmc-pmc3989032.description: Although a disease of low mortality, the global impact of foot and mouth disease (FMD) is colossal due to the huge numbers of animals affected. This impact can be separated into two components: (1) direct losses due to reduced production and changes in herd structure; and (2)...

pmc-10596963.title: Process evaluation of The Breastfeeding Trial. What factors impact the intervention delivery?
pmc-10596963.creator: H K Rossau, A K Gadeberg, K Strandberg-Larsen, IMS Nilsson, S F Villadsen
pmc-10596963.description: BackgroundBreastmilk is the ideal nutrition for infants, and breastfeeding is an important health promoting behaviour. In Denmark, most mothers initiate breastfeeding but many cease within the first months resulting in just 14% reaching the World Health Organization recommendation of six months exclusive breastfeeding.

pmc-10672836.title: An Engineered Plant Metabolic Pathway Results in High Yields of Hydroxytyrosol Due to a Modified Whole-Cell Biocatalysis in Bioreactor
pmc-10672836.creator: Glykeria Mermigka, Aikaterini I. Vavouraki, Chrysoula Nikolaou, Ioanna Cheiladaki, Michail Vourexakis, Dimitrios Goumas, Filippos Ververidis, Emmanouil Trantas
pmc-10672836.description: Hydroxytyrosol (HT) is a phenolic substance primarily present in olive leaves and olive oil. Numerous studies have shown its advantages for human health, making HT a potentially active natural component with significant added value. Determining strategies for its low-cost manufacturing by metabolic engineering in microbial factories is hence still of interest.

pmc-11607419.title: DNA breakpoints and free DNA fragments as potential predictors of infertility
pmc-11607419.creator: Yue Zhou, Juan Wang, Fan Zhang, Liguo Pei, Yue Chang, Bei Yan, Hongyan Wang
pmc-11607419.description: The study investigated the impact of varicocele on male infertility by analyzing sperm samples from 42 varicocele patients and 22 healthy individuals. Basic sperm parameters such as concentration and vitality were assessed, along with the DNA Fragmentation Index (DFI) using the SCSA method.

pmc-11712216.title: Digital assessment of turning behaviours in Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body disease and their association with cognitive function
pmc-11712216.creator: Ríona Mc Ardle, Silvia Del Din, Rana Zia Rehman, Brook Galna, Alan J Thomas, Lynn Rochester, Lisa Alcock
pmc-11712216.description: BackgroundDigital mobility outcomes (DMOs) can be captured using body‐worn inertial measurement units (IMUs) in lab‐based and real‐world environments. DMOs may support differential diagnosis of dementia; for example, Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and Lewy body disease (LBD) show unique signatures of gait impairment. Growing evidence suggests that turning impairments are related to cognitive decline.

pmc-12382179.title: Psychometrics evaluation of the Chinese version of the revised Rushton Moral Resilience Scale in registered nurses
pmc-12382179.creator: Xu Tian, Ting Shuai, Maria F Jimenez-Herrera, Aisha Al Shdefat, Hongcai Shang, Xiaoling Liu, Yi Ren
pmc-12382179.description: BackgroundRegistered nurses frequently face moral sufferings due to unavoidable ethical conflicts, which highlights the importance of moral resilience as a mitigating resource. A valid and reliable tool is essential to effectively measure moral resilience.AimThe study aimed to translate, culturally adapt, and evaluate the psychometrics of the revised Rushton Moral Resilience Scale (RMRS) for use with Chinese registered nurses.

pmc-12589424.title: Unravelling the cellular sources and location of IL-17A production during a Giardia infection
pmc-12589424.creator: Charlotte E Van Crombrugge, Bregt Decorte, Leen J M Seys, Peter Geldhof
pmc-12589424.description: IL-17A plays a crucial role in the immune defense against Giardia infection, yet its cellular sources remain incompletely defined. In this study, the site-specific expression and cellular origin of IL-17A were investigated, focusing on both adaptive and innate immune cells in the small intestine, Peyer’s patches and mesenteric lymph nodes of Giardia muris infected C57BL/6 mice.

pmc-12608299.title: Advanced Metal–Organic Framework-Based Sensor Systems for Gas and Environmental Monitoring: From Material Design to Embedded Applications
pmc-12608299.creator: Alemayehu Kidanemariam, Sungbo Cho, Cheal Kim
pmc-12608299.description: Environmental pollution is a global issue presenting risks to ecosystems and human health through release of toxic gases, existence of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in the environment, and heavy metal contamination of waters and soils. To effectively address this issue, reliable and real-time monitoring technology is imperative.

pmc-12625683.title: Trends in Private Equity Acquisitions of Assisted Living Facilities
pmc-12625683.creator: Jennifer N. Bunker, Yashaswini Singh, Gauri Gadkari, John Bowblis, Lindsey Smith, Paula Carder, Sean Huang, Momotazur Rahman, Kali S. Thomas
pmc-12625683.description: This cross-sectional study examines trends in private equity acquisitions of assisted living facilities across the US. Introduction Assisted living (AL) is a widely used long-term care option, serving nearly 1 million older adults across more than 32 000 US facilities.

pmc-13285154.title: Organ‐Specific and Conserved Regulatory Logic Orchestrates Gene Expression in the Embryonic Mesothelium
pmc-13285154.creator: Quang Minh Dang, Nicola Smart, Andia Nicole Redpath, Joaquim Miguel Vieira
pmc-13285154.description: The embryonic coelomic mesothelium acts as a critical progenitor hub during mammalian organogenesis, undergoing epithelial‐to‐mesenchymal transition (EMT) to drive vascular growth and parenchymal development in visceral organs. A prominent example is the epicardium, which plays an essential role during heart development. The principles of gene regulation in the coelomic mesothelium remain poorly defined.

pmc-13546323.title: Artificial intelligence in paediatric neuroradiology: current landscape, challenges, and future directions
pmc-13546323.creator: Brendan S. Kelly, Simon M. Clifford, Kshitij Mankad, Gabrielle C. Colleran
pmc-13546323.description: This narrative review maps the current landscape of artificial intelligence (AI) in paediatric and fetal neuroradiology, critically evaluating current practice, barriers to clinical adoption, and future potential. We searched for peer-reviewed studies from the last decade, focusing on image segmentation, lesion detection, classification, prognostication, and clinical decision support in paediatric brain imaging.

pmc-13669682.title: Novel Target for Pathogenic Leptospira Detection via Colorimetric Loop‐Mediated Isothermal Amplification (LAMP): Development, Validation, and Comparative Analysis
pmc-13669682.creator: Peyman Ghoraishizadeh, Benjie Clemente, Kween Saimuang, Sakaorat Lertjuthaporn, Sukhonta limsampan, Patcharapan Suwannin, Mongkol Techakasikornpanich, Galayanee Doungchawee, Edilberto Manahan, Kulachart Jangpatarapongsa
pmc-13669682.description: BackgroundLeptospirosis is a globally prevalent zoonotic disease that remains challenging to diagnose due to its nonspecific symptoms and the limitations of current diagnostic methods and targets. To address these challenges, we developed and validated a naked‐eye loop‐mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) assay targeting the newly identified orpH region for the rapid detection of pathogenic Leptospira species.

(a) Definitions In this section: (1) Golden parachute payment The term “golden parachute payment”— (A) means a payment (or any agreement to make a payment) in the nature of compensation for.
